text: 金十数据8月10日讯，国家统计局北京调查总队8月10日消息，2026年7月份，北京市居民消费价格指数（CPI）环比由降转涨，同比涨幅回落。从环比看，CPI由上月下降0.4%转为上涨0.2%。其中，食品价格下降0.6%，降幅较上月收窄0.6个百分点。食品中，应季水果大量上市，带动鲜果价格下降4.0%；鸡蛋供应充足，价格下降1.7%；受生猪出栏短期调整影响，猪肉价格先涨后降，全月上涨5.1%；部分主产区降雨天气较多，带动鲜菜价格上涨0.9%。从同比看，CPI上涨0.2%，涨幅比上月回落0.5个百分点。其中，食品价格下降2.6%，影响CPI下降约0.33个百分
text_en: Jin10 Data August 10 - National Bureau of Statistics Beijing Survey Team reported August 10 that in July 2026, Beijing's CPI turned to a month-on-month increase from a decline, with year-on-year growth narrowing. Month-on-month, CPI turned from a 0.4% decline last month to a 0.2% increase. Food prices fell 0.6%, with the decline narrowing by 0.6 percentage points from last month. Among foods, seasonal fruit supply boosted fresh fruit prices down 4.0%; egg supply sufficient, prices down 1.7%; pork prices rose then fell due to short-term hog slaughter adjustments, up 5.1% for the month; heavy rain in some major producing areas drove fresh vegetable prices up 0.9%. Year-on-year, CPI rose 0.2%, with growth slowing by 0.5 percentage points from last month. Food prices fell 2.6%, dragging CPI by about 0.33 percentage
